segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one who was skeptical going in, report the oil rinses away cleanly without looking or feeling greasy afterward, and one specifically recommends it alongside retinol use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin say the oil hydrates and softens their skin without the stinging or stripped feeling they get from other oil cleansers.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it balances their skin without greasy residue, dryness or new breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including some who are also acne-prone, report no irritation or breakouts, several noting they were surprised given past reactions to other cleansing oils; a couple of dissenting reports describe eye-area irritation or stinging when the oil gets directly in the eyes.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry, sensitive, or combination skin consistently report the oil leaves skin hydrated, soft and balanced rather than tight or stripped, including some who say oil cleansers usually sting or strip their dry skin but this one didn't.
concerns.redness: Two reviewers report eye-area irritation or a slight sting when the oil gets directly in the eyes; no reviewer reports general facial redness from the product, and most explicitly note no irritation on the rest of the face.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers across oily, combination, acne-prone and sensitive skin consistently report no new breakouts, with several specifically surprised given that other cleansing oils have broken them out in the past, and one reporting a significant reduction in breakouts; no reviewer in this set reports the opposite.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers, including several with oily skin, say the oil rinses away completely without a greasy residue or film, several contrasting it with other cleansing oils that need multiple rinses; two reviewers dissent, one saying it left a film on her skin and another saying it leaves an oily residue best paired with a second cleanser.

Emulsifies from oil into a milky texture

extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This was just okay. I wasn't blown away by it. I didn't think it worked super efficiently for makeup removal, and it felt like a film on my skin after I used it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] First of all - the bottle is beautiful. The top has a raised dior logo. It's fancy! The product has a light scent, so if that bothers you, skip this product. The oil feels great in your hands and works well at removing makeup. I went right for the eyes with this and it did irritate them. So a great makeup remover, not the best eye makeup remover. Based on the price, I wouldn't buy this. But I will use it and enjoy it while I have it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I wear sunscreen daily and like to double cleanse at the end of the day to make sure my skin is clean. I like that this product cleans my skin without leaving a film or any residue. I have dry skin and find that oil cleansers can sometimes cause my face to sting or leave my skin feeling too stripped - this leaves my skin clean and soft without the squeaky feeling. I also paired this with the foaming cleanser which felt so nice on my skin and is a perfect complement.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The oil feels more like water than it does a typical oil cleanser. I love this for my sensitive, acne prone skin. The foam cleanser is also light which I love because something about massive bubbles on my face doesn't appeal to me. Those bubbles are misleading. It is only slightly harsher on my sensitive skin than my CeraVe sa cleanser but I feel like this cleans far better. The scent is so good. It is light but super luxurious feeling. If you close your eyes, you really do feel like you're in a spa. I can't stand when skincare products have an overpowering fragrance so this was a clear winner for me. The packaging is nice for a plastic bottle but when I think dior, I think luxury and this bottle doesn't make me think luxury. It has a nice sleek simple modern look but it's plastic so it is what it is. I also much prefer a cleanser with a pump and not a screw cap. This is because when I'm cleaning my face, my hands and face are usually already wet so I don't like having to fumble around with a screw on cap with wet hands. But this is just my preference and it may not be an issue for many other people. My overall thoughts are the product inside the bottle is amazing but the packaging needs some work.

extraits.titre: Perfect for oily skin and retinol users, easy to emulsify
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Lowkey didnt expect to like this cleansing oil this much, but it's been sooo good for my oily skin. It doesnt feel heavy at all, but still melts off everything- even waterproof mascara ( which is kinda rare tbh ). Emulsifies super easily and rinses clean, no weird film. The scent feels kinda luxe, and even while using retinol, I didnt get any irritation (huge win). Packaging is fancy too. Only thing- it can sting a lil if it gets in your eyes, so just be careful. Honestly… kinda giving holy grail energy rn

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is great cleansing oil and would be perfect for sensitive skin types! The texture is silky and offers a nice lather on the skin once applied. It does leave an oily residue, but if you pair it with the mousse cleanser, it makes your skin feel so soft and clean! It has helped reduce my breakouts significantly.

extraits.titre: A Luxurious Cleansing Oil that Benefits the Skin!
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is the perfect first part of your double cleaning routine! I have been using this cleansing oil for a few weeks, and it feels like such a luxurious part of my skincare routine. The oil spreads easily, melting away even the most waterproof of make up. I love that it lathers up a little, and you do not have to put too much pressure or scrubbing motion in to get your make up to remove, reducing irritation and pulling on your eyelashes. The oil emulsifies easily, and after you rinse it off, you can feel the moisture absorbed into your skin. As someone with skin that leans toward combination, I was also happy this did not break out my skin. The scent and packaging are also beautiful, and it feels like the first step of a high quality spa routine. I highly recommend investing in this high quality oil for your skincare routine!
